content.value: Decision logic is core to web interactivity. Conditional branches control what appears or runs, and loops process repeated datasets. Mastering these primitives lets you build dynamic UI behavior and avoid duplicated code.

concepts.name: if statement
concepts.description: A JavaScript control-flow statement that runs code when a condition is true.

concepts.name: for loop
concepts.description: A loop that repeats once for each item in a sequence or iterable.

concepts.name: while loop
concepts.description: A loop that repeats as long as its condition remains true.

concepts.name: Array iteration
concepts.description: Processing each item in an array using a loop or array method.

concepts.name: Control flow
concepts.description: The order and branching path through which code executes.

concepts.name: Loop termination
concepts.description: The condition or event that causes a loop to stop running.
